1.consolidated_definition: Dícese del alimento o bebida que su gusto vuelve a la boca después de haberla ingerido, en algunos casos causando eructos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: This is referred to as the food or drink whose taste returns to the mouth after it has been ingested, in some cases causing belches.
